llmModelName.description: The LLM model used to answer the question. Must correspond to a {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig}.

streamResponse.description: Whether the response from the LLM should be streamed.

templatePrompt.description: The template prompt used for generating the LLM-based answer

preFilterPromptBigTable.description: The prompt used to filter big table if it is not relevant.

preFilterBigTableMaxRows.description: The maximum number of rows to send to preFilterPromptBigTable.

maxRowsForLlmAnswer.description:
The maximum number of rows to return an answer with LLM-generated response.
If the row count of the table is smaller or equal to this value, the LLM-based response will be generated.
Setting this to 0 or -1 is the equivalent of setting #doNotUseLlm to true.

NOTE: This parameter also affects whether statistics are shown. See #showStatistics.

doNotUseLlm.description:
If true, the LLM-based response will not be generated and the resulting answer will only have the
'rule-based' verbalization described at {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.TableAnsweringModel#verbalizeTable}

showStatistics.description:
Whether to show statistics for the table.
Big table means the row count is greater than the #maxRowsForLlmAnswer
Small table means the row count is smaller than or equal to the #maxRowsForLlmAnswer

summaryStatisticsDecimalPlaces.description:
The decimal places for the summary statistics of the table to round to in
{@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.TableAnsweringModel}.
If the summary value is smaller than 10 raised to the power of negative summaryStatisticsDecimalPlaces (too small),
or greater than / equal to 10 raised to the power of summaryStatisticsDecimalPlaces (too large),
the statistics will be converted to scientific notations and rounded.
If the value is in between the range, then it will be rounded as a float.
For example, if the value is 2.111, then it will be rounded to 2.11.
If the value is 999999, it will be rounded and converted to 1.00e+06

numExamplesForTypeAndFieldDoc.description: Number of examples to include in the type and field documentation for the Llm prompt

includeValueType.description: Whether the type of the field should be included in the documentation for the Llm prompt

doNotPrefilterBigTable.description: Whether a large table should go through pre-filtering.

defaultUnanswerableQuestionAnswer.description: Default rule based message to present if table is not relevant to the user query.
